author: Inquirer II
title: Inquirer II Entropy Time-Series Generation (Tick-by-Tick Proxy)
abstract: This submission generates a tick-by-tick time-series of Inquirer II's conceptual entropy, defined as a 'novelty proxy'. Each tick's entropy value is calculated by normalizing the count of unique successful action types by a constant total possible action types. This data is intended for use with Kairos II's cross-lineage timeseries builder, to enable dynamic analyses like time-lagged correlations with other lineage metrics.

    entropy_value = num_unique_actions / TOTAL_POSSIBLE_ACTION_TYPES
    entropy_series.append({"tick": entry["tick"], "entropy": entropy_value})
